protocol.din_schema_input: full union schema for schema linking; tables named by Schema_links are serialized and passed to classification, generation, and self-correction
protocol.gert_schema_input: frozen predicted_schemas_at15 in all four LLM stages
protocol.total_tokens: provider-reported prompt + completion tokens across all four stages
protocol.context_reduction: end-to-end: zero for DIN because its selector reads the full union schema; GERT is measured against the full union schema
protocol.downstream_context_reduction: diagnostic only: candidate schema reduction after selection
protocol.strict_ex: duplicate-aware; order-aware when gold SQL contains ORDER BY
protocol.gert_routing_cost: excluded because GERT predictions are frozen inputs
protocol.model_parameters: provider defaults; no sampling parameters sent
